desc:
Made by @ifqiyeh, follow me on Roblox! https://www.roblox.com/users/321717747/profile

A made in Singapore, Nusantara & Islamic mixed horror game. Best experience with high quality on PC & solo.

Features:
- 4 different stories
- Voice-Enabled
- Multiplayer
- Mobile Compatibility

Guide:
Look at guide menu [G] for keybinds and guide.

Older and poor performance devices should be able to run fine in low graphics and higher-speed Internet connection.

Developed by Muslim Malay Singaporean.
